usedFor: viral.app tracks short-form video campaigns and HubSpot tracks the customers behind them. A “New Campaign” in Viral can run “Create Deal”, handy for an agency whose every campaign is a paying account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Viral, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A campaign is the unit of work you bill for, so a deal per campaign keeps the pipeline in step with what is live.

watchOut: “New Campaign” is polling, so it checks on a schedule and the deal arrives a little late. “Update Deal” needs the ID of an existing deal.
